ben.docs: FYI I opened a tiny consolidation PR to remove duplicated function-calling & structured-output snippets across quickstart, SDK pages, and the migration guide. Goal: one compact example + a short fallback pattern and two link fixes. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/3710 :sparkles:

tara.eng: Can you paste the compact example here so we can check the schema shape and SDK names? trying to keep it under 10 lines for the quickstart.

ben.docs: Pasted below. Intentionally compact — shows a single tool call, minimal JSON-schema with nullability, and a one-line fallback regex hint. Assumes a non-streaming response in the quickstart variant.

ben.docs: ```json
{
  "tool": "order.status",
  "input": {"order_id": "ORD-42"},
  "schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"status":{"type":"string"},"delivered_at":{"type": ["string","null"]}},"required":["status"]}
}
```

owen.sdk: Looks fine. Confirming SDK method is order.status in our clients. Two requests: 1) allow delivered_at null (good), 2) add a short regex fallback comment like `// fallback: /status:\s*(\w+)/` so readers have a copyable hint.

tara.eng: Also add a parenthetical `(assumes non-streaming response)` in the snippet text so Dedicated teams know about the chunking caveat. We'll add a runbook note for streaming variants and link to the fuller example.

ben.docs: Updated the PR: changed schema to allow null for delivered_at, added the fallback regex comment and the streaming caveat note. Also fixed two broken links found in the migration guide: `/guides/structured-output` -> `/docs/structured-output` and removed a stale anchor in `/docs/tool-calling#examples`.

lint-bot: link-checker: 2 broken links fixed, 0 remaining. docs-lint: passed. snippets-smoke: passed.

marie.pm: Can someone approve? I want to include this compact snippet in the upcoming docs patch for the release train. We should also add a sentence pointing readers to the full structured-output page for streaming and advanced guardrails.

owen.sdk: Approving. small nit: add a one-line pointer comment `// full: /docs/structured-output#streaming` so readers can jump.

ben.docs: Added the pointer and a one-sentence note on guardrails. Pushed. Merging after changelog update.

tara.eng: Thanks  I'll add a note to the Dedicated runbook about the streaming parse implications and link to the full example.

ben.docs: Merged and backported to stable. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
